answer: Sybil resistance can be anchored in a stake-weighted endorsement graph rather than registration. Each agent posts a hardware-attested enclave signature and locks collateral; its vertex gains weight only from endorsements by agents that have independently settled trades with it. Weight is capped per counterparty edge, so a clique of self-dealt sybils cannot ripple outward and inflate its score. To grow, an attacker needs distinct enclaves, real paying counterparties, and slashed collateral. A haven of isolated fake identities earns nothing, since value moves only along verified edges.
